**Roles, backups, and a lot more control over every issue you send**

- **Built for more than one person.** Give people the **admin**, **editor**, or **viewer** role. Forgot your password? **Forgot password?** emails a reset link, and a recovery command works even without email. Signed-in users can **Link SSO** to their account from their profile.
- **Backed up for you.** LatestArr now backs up its database every day and before every upgrade, and keeps the backups you choose. The Backups page shows at a glance whether you're covered, and gives you the restore commands ready to copy. Point `BACKUP_PATH` at another disk or a NAS.
- **Make every issue yours.** Add your logo (with a dark mode version), choose colours for labels, buttons, and links, and style every button, including **Watch on Plex**. Format the intro and footer note with bold, links, and lists. The design editor now follows the order of the email, and each section says what's set. Subjects can now fill in the date, period, and counts, like "{count} new from {period}".
- **Recipients and sending, sorted.** Import from a CSV or Excel file with a groups column, see exactly what will change first, and undo the last import. If a send only reaches some people, **Send to the rest** finishes it without duplicates. Saving works the same way everywhere, including a recipient's groups. The image now runs natively on ARM (Apple Silicon, Raspberry Pi).

### Before you upgrade

- **LatestArr backs itself up before upgrading,** and migrations run automatically. Keep a copy of your `ENCRYPTION_KEY` somewhere safe; backups don't include it.
- **Everyone who could sign in before is an admin.** Review the **Users** page and give people the editor or viewer role where that fits.
- **Recipient imports now update names** of people already on your list. Before, those rows were skipped.
- **On an ARM host,** you can drop any `--platform linux/amd64` you added to run earlier versions.
